items.title: Time Machine for Point-in-Time Web Retrieval
items.what_en: Perplexity launched Time Machine for its Search API and Context API, enabling developers and agents to search and read the web using copies saved at or before a specified timestamp. This feature, which can access historical data up to 365 days old, is designed to prevent information leakage in evaluations by restricting retrieval to data available at a chosen past point.
items.how_to_try: Available for developers and agents through Perplexity's Search API and Context API.

items.title: Canada-Hosted Open-Weight AI Platform
items.what_en: MapleLLM, a Toronto-based company, launched its Canada-hosted AI inference service for developers and businesses. This platform provides open-weight large language models and is built on sovereign Canadian GPU infrastructure.
items.how_to_try: Intended for developers and businesses utilizing an AI inference service.
